chunks: Regarding the mu'adhdhins: “Indeed, they are the trustworthy ones.”

key_terms.الْأُمَنَاءُ: the trustworthy ones; people entrusted with a religious duty
key_terms.الْمُؤَذِّنِينَ: those who give the call to salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the mu'adhdhins?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describes the mu'adhdhins as trustworthy people. The hadith highlights the moral and communal importance of those who call the believers to salat (prayer).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.898 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said

regarding the mu'adhdhins (callers to prayer):
"They are the trustworthy ones”.
